daily.brief: 過去約25.5小時內，55個帳號發出220則相關帖文。共同看好最明顯的是$AMZN（4個帳號），AWS超預期、產能仍受供應限制是主要理由，@OptionsMike關注225附近；$AAPL亦有3個帳號看多，@TrendSpider把目標定在400美元。沒有純共同看淡，但$GOOGL與$TSLA出現明顯分歧。
daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最集中的是$AMZN，4個帳號明確看多，相關帖文17則。@OptionsMike說零售端未達預期但AWS超出預期，指引2027年40%成長、2028年再度大幅成長，資本支出是一生一次機會，大幅反彈，關注225附近。原帖 @TheTranscript_提到AWS約每14秒安裝一顆AI加速器，產能仍受供應限制，客戶吸收速度很快，核心運算與儲存營收成長率達數年來最快。原帖 @Mr_Derivatives則指$META、$GOOGL與$AMZN均低於50日與200日移動平均線，歷史上在主要均線以下買入這些優質股票通常獲得回報，除非預期更深層的2022年式熊市回撤。原帖

$AAPL有3個帳號看多。@TrendSpider直接說蘋果將目標定在400美元。原帖 @charliebilello表示蘋果現在是今年唯一跑贏標普500的Magnificent 7股票，因為它產生比任何其他Mag 7公司更多的自由現金流，同時基本上避免了正在消耗其超大規模同業的資本支出。原帖 @bespokeinvest指出大型科技股近期走勢分歧，$AAPL與$MSFT是僅有的兩檔處於上升趨勢者。原帖

$MSFT同樣有3個帳號看多。@OptionsMike說財報出色，且是唯一現金流為正的超大規模雲端商，但隨後宣佈至少250億美元債券發行，視其為反彈時首選，並關注50日線。原帖 @Mr_Derivatives表示今年早些時候他全面看好MSFT，稱其為美妙的底部。原帖 $META有2個帳號看多，@OptionsMike說債務債務債務，但他們在Muse上表現出色，會開始小幅買入，理解它可能跌至540或更低，那將是撿便宜。原帖

共同看淡

今日沒有純共同看淡的代號（bear_total為0）。不過在分歧名單中，空方聲音仍存在，尤其在財報後的個股上。

分歧

$SPCX是今日分歧之一（3多1淡），相關帖文9則。@elonmusk表示其他超級運算項目無法達到目標，但SpaceX已經在實現我們的目標，引用帖描述SpaceXAI在孟菲斯的Colossus 2是世界最強大的AI數據中心。原帖 @SawyerMerritt說每週對SpaceX越來越看好，他們開發的技術、快速部署速度和製造能力遠遠領先，公司「只有」1.8萬億美元市值實際上很瘋狂。原帖 但@TrendSpider指出一項針對$SPCX的日間交易策略自上市以來回報為28%，而該資產本身下跌10%。原帖

$TSLA2多1淡。@OptionsMike說週五走勢堅挺，收在8日線上方且高於所有均線，若反彈則關注410，相對較強標的。原帖 @TrendSpider說特斯拉終於突破其2026年下跌趨勢。原帖 但@garyblack00擔心電動車市佔率已由80%穩步下降至目前的52%，是誰獲得了市佔？數學上必須等於100%，因此若非所列7家，必有其他業者獲得市佔。原帖

$GOOGL1多1淡，帖文16則。@TheTranscript_引述Alphabet執行長：Google每分鐘處理320億AI令牌，同比增長超過4倍，第一方模型API每分鐘近320億令牌，比上季多40%，比一年前多超過4倍。原帖 但@OptionsMike說財報極差，護城河正在侵蝕，廣告／搜尋／YouTube未達預期，明年資本支出大幅提高且自由現金流為負，或許273能守住，關注死貓反彈。原帖

$COIN與$HOOD各1多1淡。@TrendSpider對$COIN指出僅做多演算法回測期間+74%，而股票同期下跌63%，剛發出再次上漲信號；對$HOOD則有策略回測回報+1,072%對比買入持有+849%。但@OptionsMike因財報平淡加上幣安駭客事件看淡$COIN，稱周線圖上若此位失守即跌破長期支撐；對$HOOD則說財報不佳加上加密市場受打擊而偏弱，週五低點為支撐，否則或看73。原帖 原帖

其他值得留意

記憶體相關名稱在週末指標中表現較強，@Mr_Derivatives引用Liquid更新：買家在週五科技股拋售殘骸中挑選，超過80%追蹤合約高於週五收盤，$MU上漲2.23%。原帖 整體上，財報後的大型科技股分化明顯，AI敘事仍在，但個股基本面與技術位置成為主要分歧點。

今日市場重點

過去約25.5小時內，55個帳號發出220則相關帖文。共同看好以$AMZN為首（4個帳號），@OptionsMike說AWS超預期、指引2027年40%成長，關注225附近；$AAPL有3個帳號看多，@TrendSpider把目標定在400美元。沒有純共同看淡，但$GOOGL分歧明顯，@TheTranscript_強調AI令牌同比增長超過4倍，@OptionsMike則說財報極差、護城河侵蝕，或許273能守住。最大提及的包括$AMZN與大型科技，AI敘事仍主導，但財報後個股分化大於指數單一方向。週線共同看淡同樣由$RDDT領頭（10個帳號）。

daily.brief: Over the past ~25.5 hours, 55 accounts posted 220 related items. Clearest common bullish is $AMZN (4 accounts), with AWS beat and supply-constrained capacity as main reasons; @OptionsMike is watching near 225. $AAPL also has 3 bullish accounts, with @TrendSpider setting a $400 target. No pure common bearish, but $GOOGL and $TSLA show clear divergence.
daily.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish today is $AMZN, with 4 accounts long and 17 related posts. @OptionsMike said retail missed but AWS beat expectations, guiding 40% growth in 2027 and another big step-up in 2028; capex is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, sharp bounce, watching near 225. post @TheTranscript_ noted AWS installing an AI accelerator about every 14 seconds, capacity still supply-constrained, customers absorbing quickly, core compute and storage revenue growth at multi-year highs. post @Mr_Derivatives pointed out $META, $GOOGL and $AMZN are all below 50-day and 200-day moving averages; historically buying quality names below major MAs has paid off unless expecting a deeper 2022-style bear market drawdown. post

$AAPL has 3 bullish accounts. @TrendSpider directly said Apple is targeting $400. post @charliebilello said Apple is now the only Magnificent 7 stock outperforming the S&P 500 this year because it generates more free cash flow than any other Mag 7 company while largely avoiding the capex that is consuming its hyperscale peers. post @bespokeinvest noted large tech has diverged recently, with $AAPL and $MSFT the only two in uptrends. post

$MSFT also has 3 bullish accounts. @OptionsMike said the report was strong and it is the only positive-cash-flow hyperscaler, but then announced at least $25B in bond issuance; he sees it as the preferred bounce name and is watching the 50-day. post @Mr_Derivatives said earlier this year he was fully bullish on MSFT, calling it a beautiful bottom. post $META has 2 bullish accounts; @OptionsMike said debt debt debt, but they are performing well on Muse, he will start buying small, understanding it could go to 540 or lower, which would be a bargain for him. post

Common Bearish

No pure common bearish tickers today (bear_total is 0). However, bearish voices still appear in the split list, especially on post-earnings names.

Divergence

$SPCX is one of today's splits (3 long / 1 short), with 9 related posts. @elonmusk said other supercomputing projects cannot hit their targets, but SpaceX is already achieving ours; the quoted post described SpaceXAI's Colossus 2 in Memphis as the world's most powerful AI data center. post @SawyerMerritt said he is getting more bullish on SpaceX every week; their technology, deployment speed and manufacturing capability are far ahead, and a $1.8T market cap is actually crazy. post But @TrendSpider noted a day-trading strategy on $SPCX has returned 28% since listing while the asset itself is down 10%. post

$TSLA is 2 long / 1 short. @OptionsMike said Friday's action was firm, closed above the 8-day and all moving averages; if it bounces watch 410, relatively strong name. post @TrendSpider said Tesla has finally broken its 2026 downtrend. post But @garyblack00 worries EV market share has steadily fallen from 80% to currently 52%; who gained the share? Mathematically it must equal 100%, so if not the listed 7, other players must have gained. post

$GOOGL is 1 long / 1 short, with 16 posts. @TheTranscript_ cited Alphabet's CEO: Google processes 32 billion AI tokens per minute, up more than 4x year-over-year; first-party model API near 32 billion tokens per minute, up 40% from last quarter and more than 4x from a year ago. post But @OptionsMike said the report was terrible, the moat is eroding, ads/search/YouTube missed, next year's capex is sharply higher and free cash flow is negative; perhaps 273 can hold, watching a dead-cat bounce. post

$COIN and $HOOD are each 1 long / 1 short. @TrendSpider on $COIN noted a long-only algorithm backtest returned +74% while the stock fell 63% over the same period and just issued another upside signal; on $HOOD a strategy backtest returned +1,072% vs buy-and-hold +849%. But @OptionsMike is bearish on $COIN due to a bland report plus the Binance hack, saying on the weekly chart if this level is lost it breaks long-term support; on $HOOD he said weak due to poor earnings plus crypto market hit from the hack, Friday's low is support otherwise look toward 73. post post

Other Notable

Memory-related names showed relative strength in weekend indicators; @Mr_Derivatives cited Liquid update that buyers were picking through Friday's tech sell-off wreckage, over 80% of tracked contracts above Friday's close, $MU up 2.23%. post Overall, large tech has diverged sharply post-earnings; AI narrative remains, but individual fundamentals and technical levels are the main points of disagreement.

Consensus

Clearest common bullish over the past week is $SOFI, with 8 accounts long. @OptionsMike said the report was good and it is easy to bounce after the sharp pullback; needs to reclaim the 200-day, and if it falls again there is a gap below. post @Jake__Wujastyk noted the monthly candle has recovered quite a bit. post $SKHY has 4 bullish accounts; @ThetaWarrior cited an earlier note that scanners took profits this morning for a total profit of $4,061,300. post $LLY and $IWM each have 4 bullish accounts; @APompliano cited views that Eli Lilly will become the world's most valuable company, benefiting from ongoing healthcare spending plus heavy AI investment. post

Common Bearish

Top common bearish is $RDDT (10 accounts). @OptionsMike said wow, post-earnings from 135 to 91; simply put, 80 is your line, break below could be worse. post @ripster47 called it a major disappointment, daily active users missed, they closed longs around $135, describing it as an easy 100 PSYCH short setup. post $MRVL and $BA each have 4 bearish accounts; $MSTR and $RBLX each have 3.

Divergence

There are 51 tickers in the split list this week. Large tech has diverged sharply post-earnings, with some accounts focusing on technical levels and cash flow while others worry about capex and market-share changes. At the index level longs and shorts coexist, with no one-way consensus.

Other Notable

@OptionsMike sees names like $LLY as defensive and is watching a 160 breakout. Memory and semiconductor discussion continued through the week, coexisting with post-earnings internet/semiconductor selloffs.
